scope: 173 explicit-stack Writer::ty and Reader::ty traversal repair, legacy schema20 format and default bounded metadata behavior only.
static_review: Writer sequences one borrowed child at a time using continuations; Record field names precede each child, Enum variant counts precede fields, Array length follows its child, and function result follows all parameters.
Reader continuation stacks isolate nested values, field names and enum variants. Finishing a nested record/enum splits only its saved suffix; parent state remains intact.
Both sides check depth before charging each node and charge collection size before scheduling traversal. The implementation does not pre-expand an uncharged collection into task entries.
Node and collection accounting, type tags 0 through 25, public protocol version20 and typed-schema fingerprint domain are unchanged by this patch.
No raw input becomes trusted: decode still returns public candidate types and independent Verify remains mandatory.

independent_oracle.method: Independent handwritten legacy type byte encoder and node-cost counter, obtained from the pre-rewrite schema20 layout at 893b625; production Writer/Reader do not call it.
special_cases: nested enum inside record inside enum with later sibling variants
independent_oracle.exact_node_boundary: For each fixture, both Writer and Reader pass at 2 CT list entries + oracle type cost, and both ResourceLimit at N-1.

stack_probes.reader_bytes: Handwritten Tuple tag4/count1 stream; not produced by the new Writer.
